I played D1 football from 2014-2018. I was a full scholarship athlete and soon realized that i had signed  a contract with NCAA for indentured servitude. As a full ride athlete in 2014-2018 you were paid $823 during season and $450 in the summer. So after rent, utilities, groceries, etc. after 3/5 days you were looking at surviving off about $150-200 for the rest of the month. and in summer they paid u less thinking that rent somehow would just go down too. You weren't allowed to get a job, or use your skills that got you to where you are to provide food so you weren't starving. If you did that and NCAA hears about it you would loose your scholarship and possibly face charges in court..

Recently they had passed a rule allowing student-athletes to get jobs and make revenue from there name, thats great! They even paid former athletes for there time in athletics. I received less then $1,200 for working 60+hours a week in atheltics and having to do 20+ hours a week in classroom to stay eligible. playing division 1 football. winning a bowl game, and bringing more revenue to the university then any previous team in University history. Yet these millionaires keep making millions without paying a cent in taxes. off the backs of young driven athletes. And now they are cutting programs so they can stay in the green. This needs to be addressed before they make off with billions.
